Angehängt: 1 Bild

In early April 2021 GEO600's laser system reached ten years of operating time.

The GEO600 laser system was installed in September 2010. In 2021 it had been running longer than the systems used in the other large gravitational-wave detectors. The laser has been running continuously nearly all the time.

An @mpi_grav and @unihannover@wisskomm.social team together with the Laser Zentrum Hannover e.V. has developed and provided the high-power laser systems for the large interferometric gravitational-wave detectors. The experience gained by running earlier generations of these systems at GEO600 was crucial to this success.

It’s not known whether the laser did receive a birthday cake on the occasion.
